judgments.reasoning_cat2: Nothing else in the Memorandum addresses hiring displaced employees of other papers, so no conflict arises.
judgments.clause_name: Side letter — Closure of Daily News or Post

judgments.reasoning_cat1: A specific award of a named position, days off and start time; nothing to construe.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: An individual settlement standing apart from the staffing provisions; no conflict identified.
judgments.clause_name: Side letter — M. Santor grievance settlement (position awarded)

judgments.reasoning_cat1: A single definite undertaking to withdraw the grievance with prejudice.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: It is the consideration for the preceding paragraph and is consistent with the grievance machinery in section 2.
judgments.clause_name: Side letter — M. Santor withdrawal of grievance
